decision_policy: As token-catalog-2026-11-24: a deployment is listed when the issuer names the exact identifier on the exact network. A token replaced by a one-way upgrade is not kept beside its successor. Live pages were read with curl on the date above.

sources.excerpt: Aero core Contract Chains Address AERO token ( Token ) Base 0x3f5bF3EdAc59d650D8fDf9657a71F2f904A3a4Ee VotingEscrow Base 0xBF7977E1521e9a3032bf7243Ee4712f311f13915
Aero runs on several networks, but AERO itself only exists on Base. On every other network, AERO rewards are paid in xAERO, a standard ERC-20 receipt token that stands in for AERO on that network.
All official contract addresses, including the AERO token, are listed on the Aero docs security page .

deployments.note: CoinPaprika lists no coin for this contract (search for aero; /v1/contracts/base-base/<address> answers "contract not found"), so the token carries no coinpaprika_id.

sources.excerpt: What is the conversion rate? 1 AERO becomes 1 AERO. 1 VELO becomes 0.044 AERO.

AERO and VELO emissions on Aerodrome and Velodrome stopped at launch. To earn AERO Rewards as an LP or Exchange Revenue as a token operator, you need to upgrade. Is there a deadline to upgrade? There is no set deadline.
All tokens need to be upgraded through the Upgrade portal. Nothing converts automatically.
Aerodrome Finance (AERO) has been rebranded to Aero (AERO). They migrated from their old contract to a new contract.

deployments.note: The legacy token still trades (CoinGecko prices it with the new one) and upgrades one way, 1:1, through the portal on aerodrome.finance; CoinPaprika's aero-aerodrome-finance is this contract.
